name: After recital 7
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2017/1938 as regards the role of gas storage for securing gas supplies ahead of the winter season
part_text: (7 d) Member States should remain free to use the AggregateEU mechanism or not. Participation should remain strictly voluntary, without making it conditional on the assessment of their compliance or their access to other European instruments.
